name: @aos/knowledge-auto-update
description: AOS Enterprise Knowledge Auto Update — the standalone, in-memory engine that detects, schedules, validates, refreshes, synchronizes, and updates knowledge assets throughout the Knowledge Runtime. Provides a deterministic priority-queue-and-cron-model scheduler, a real 10-stage update pipeline, 13 update-type strategies, dependency-aware ordering, conflict resolution, staleness analysis, exponential backoff retry, and 16 computed metrics. Pure domain: no database, no network, no filesystem persistence, no OS-dependent timers — everything in-memory and driven by an injectable clock. This package imports ZERO other @aos/* packages at runtime; it defines its own exception base class, its own lightweight event-publishing mechanism, and its own module contract so it remains fully standalone.
